fonts.display: 'sans-serif', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Libre Caslon Text', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Forest Grove
palette.role: Primary brand color — used for the logo mark, the signature word in serif headlines, accent borders on tags and announcement pills, and small icon highlights. A deep, slightly desaturated green that reads as clinical and trustworthy rather than energetic

palette.name: Pine Shadow
palette.role: Secondary dark surface — a near-black green-tinted shade for inverted buttons and dark surface moments where #000 would feel too harsh against the green accent

palette.name: Ink Black
palette.role: Dark borders and separators for elevated surfaces and inverted UI. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Secondary text and dividers — a mid-dark gray for body copy de-emphasis, subtle borders, and metadata

palette.name: Slate Mid
palette.role: Muted helper text, inactive labels, and tertiary metadata — sits at a comfortable AA contrast against white

palette.name: Mist Gray
palette.role: Card surface and the only neutral fill color in the system. Creates a single elevated tier above the white canvas without introducing a new hue

palette.name: Pure White
palette.role: Page canvas, card-internal backgrounds, and inverse text on dark fills

palette.name: Shadow Smoke
palette.role: Box-shadow base color for the soft elevation that sits behind cards and the floating product mockup on the right side of the hero
